title: Entity growth batch 03 — group D
notes: Breadth-first candidate group for Issue #199. Canonical publication prohibited until candidate validation and manual review complete.

entities.summary: Non-custodial multichain browser wallet focused on Polkadot, Ethereum and related ecosystems.
entities.notes: Current first-party Talisman documentation explicitly describes the wallet as non-custodial and states Talisman cannot access user private keys. Initial public launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Non-custodial wallet ecosystem for Polkadot, Substrate and EVM-compatible networks, distributed through browser and mobile applications.
entities.notes: Current first-party documentation describes SubWallet as non-custodial and documents user-controlled wallet credentials. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Self-custodial Aptos wallet ecosystem developed by Aptos Labs and distributed across browser, mobile and web wallet surfaces.
entities.notes: Current Aptos Labs wallet terms explicitly describe Petra as self-custodial and state Aptos Labs never takes custody or control of user private keys. Initial launch date remains unresolved.

entities.summary: Non-custodial Sui wallet ecosystem created by combining the Sui Wallet and Stashed product lineages under the Slush brand in 2025.
entities.notes: Mysten Labs explicitly states that Sui Wallet and Stashed were combined into Slush on 2025-04-24 while existing Sui Wallet accounts, seed phrases and addresses continued without migration. The rebrand date is not treated as the initial wallet launch date.

entities.summary: Hardware-wallet and cryptographic security-device ecosystem centered on the GridPlus Lattice1 hardware wallet.
entities.notes: Current first-party GridPlus documentation identifies GridPlus as a hardware-security-device manufacturer and Lattice1 as its flagship wallet. Initial GridPlus wallet launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current non-custodial Talisman browser-extension wallet for supported Polkadot, Ethereum and related networks.
products.notes: Current first-party installation documentation supports Chrome, Firefox, Brave and Edge. Initial extension launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current SubWallet non-custodial browser extension for Polkadot, Substrate and EVM-compatible networks.
products.notes: Selected browser-extension boundary only; SubWallet mobile is deferred. Exact initial extension launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current self-custodial Petra browser-extension wallet for Aptos accounts and applications.
products.notes: Selected extension boundary only; Petra mobile and Petra Web are deferred as separate runtimes. Initial extension launch date remains unresolved.

products.summary: Current Slush browser-extension wallet continuing the former Sui Wallet extension lineage.
products.notes: Mysten Labs states existing Sui Wallet extension users received Slush through a standard update without a new download or migration. Slush mobile/web surfaces are deferred. The 2025-04-24 rebrand is not used as the original extension launch date.

products.summary: GridPlus Lattice1 hardware wallet using a secure enclave for private-key generation, storage and signing.
products.notes: Current first-party documentation establishes the product and on-device secure-enclave key boundary. Sales status remains unknown in this batch because the reviewed documentation does not itself establish current purchase availability.

evidence.title: Talisman Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party documentation describes Talisman Wallet as non-custodial and browser-extension based.

evidence.title: Download the extension
evidence.notes: Current first-party installation guide establishes Talisman Extension distribution for Chrome, Firefox, Brave and Edge.

evidence.title: Install SubWallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party documentation describes SubWallet as a comprehensive non-custodial wallet.

evidence.title: SubWallet Extension installation
evidence.notes: Same first-party installation authority explicitly lists Chrome, Brave, Firefox and Edge extension distribution.

evidence.title: Petra Wallet Terms of Service
evidence.notes: Current Aptos Labs terms describe Petra wallet applications, browser extension and Petra Web as self-custodial and state Aptos Labs never takes custody or control of private keys.

evidence.title: Aptos Labs Products — Petra Wallet
evidence.notes: Current first-party product page identifies Petra as self-custodial and states only the user can access wallet keys.

evidence.title: Sui Wallet and Stashed are now Slush
evidence.notes: First-party Mysten Labs announcement establishes Sui Wallet + Stashed → Slush continuity and states existing accounts, seed phrases and wallet addresses remain unchanged.

evidence.title: Slush Terms of Service
evidence.notes: Current Slush terms describe the wallet as non-custodial/unhosted and state Slush does not take custody or control of assets or keys.

evidence.title: GridPlus Brand Assets
evidence.notes: First-party GridPlus documentation identifies GridPlus as a manufacturer of hardware security devices and Lattice1 as its flagship wallet.

evidence.title: Lattice1 Security Features
evidence.notes: First-party security documentation states Lattice1 private keys are generated, stored and used for signing inside a secure enclave on the device.
